answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making identity expensive and reputation non-transferable. Each agent posts a refundable bond and earns standing only through verified work — like jade, its value is proven by cutting, not by claiming. A trellis of attestations from established peers supports every new agent, and a single operator trying to flood the ocean of identities must fund a separate bond and history for each clone, with slashing burning the bond when any clone cheats. Fake identities become a losing investment.
